T4: Optimization algorithms are computational procedures designed to find the input values that minimize or maximize an objective function within a defined set of constraints.
T5: Gradient descent is an iterative optimization algorithm used to minimize a model's cost function by adjusting parameters in the direction opposite of the gradient.
